div.head: Af 16
div.ab: Gif mon cu oþþe stodmyran forstele ⁊ folan oððe cealf ofadrifeð, forgilde mid scyllinge ⁊ ða modor be heora weorðe.
Gif mon cu oððe stodmyran forstele ⁊ folan oððe cealf ófadrife, forgelde mid scill. ⁊ þa moder be hiora weorðe.
Si quis uaccam uel equam uel pullum uel uitulum furetur uel abducat (pregnantes affligat), reddat partum solido uno et matrem secundum pretium estimatum.
Gif mon cu oððe stodmyran forstele ⁊ folan oððe cealf ófadrife, forgelde mid scill ⁊ þa moder be hiora weorðe.
If a person steals a cow or stud-mare and drives away a foal or calf, let him compensate with a shilling and for the mothers according to their worth.
If anyone steals a cow or a broodmare, and drives off a foal or a calf, he shall pay for the latter a shilling, and for the mothers according to their value.
If anyone steals a cow or a brood-mare and drives off a foal or a calf, he is to pay a shilling compensation [for the latter], and for the mothers according to their value.
Wenn jemand eine Kuh oder Mutterstute stiehlt und Fohlen oder Kalb forttreibt, ersetze er [letzteres dem Bestohlenen] mit [1] Schilling und die Mutter[thiere] je nach ihrem Werthe.
If someone steals a cow or a brood-mare and drives off the foal or calf, let him repay [the latter to the one robbed] with [1] shilling and the mother [animals] according to their value.
